reviews.comment: Butler is probably the best prof for MSEN 201. You do a lot of questions through the online textbook and you can get extra credit through in class activities. It is a moderately easy class if you put in the time, he provides very generous partial credit.

He's a really great prof and makes learning these sometimes boring concepts interesting. There are only 3 or 4 grades though, depending if you take the graduate-level course. Take the practice quizzes and pay attention, and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Butler really cares about his students understanding the material. He does not go overly fast on lecture slides. Attendance isn't necessary BUT there are in class activities that are basically free points if you them turn in! Sometimes he does bring small demos in order to make lecture more engaging.

Professor Butler is very well spoken and really cares about the material, as well as if his students pass or not. Lectures are straightforward, homework can be hard sometimes so make sure to read the textbook if you're stuck. He offers a few extra credit assignments, but they're not necessary to pass. Good teacher overall
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There's a lot of ground to cover in this course, but Dr. Butler makes things fun when he can and offers extra credit options. He's really generous with partial credit on tests and wants to make things right if he does mess up.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT
